title: Novartis CEO and Anthropic board member Vas Narasimhan doubts AI will cure cancer in 5-10 years, arguing tech's "engineering mindset" overlooks human biology (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: Novartis CEO and Anthropic board member Vas Narasimhan doubts AI will cure cancer in 5-10 years, arguing tech's “engineering mindset” overlooks human biology — Comments from pharma CEO follow ambitious claims from Anthropic chief and DeepMind founder
